fullPassage: Religious beliefs do have some major positive effects. For example, many people that run charities helping the poor and disadvantaged are motivated by their religious outlook. It is also obvious that such beliefs have inspired and stimulated many forms of art, especially painting, sculpture, architecture and music. You have only to look up at the Sistine Chapel ceiling in St. Peter's in Rome or listen to the King's College Choir in Cambridge to realise this. Science has not inspired art to anything like the same extent, but in my personal view, what science is doing is revealing a Universe whose complexity and beauty surpasses anything imagined by supernaturalists. To appreciate this, look at the breathtaking photographs taken by the Hubble Space Telescope. On the other hand, science lacks for some, but by no means all, people, the same emotional appeal as religion - it presents a view of human life that is bleak and joyless by comparison, because of the absence of any discernable, overall purpose in the Universe. This view conflicts with the purpose-driven, individual lives that we all lead. This relative lack of appeal is probably the main reason why the majority of people confine their interest in science to its useful applications or dangers, and turn to religion to seek meaning and comfort, especially in times of grief and hardship. Belief in the supernatural provides the possibility of hope in circumstances where a naturalistic approach might provide none. As the poet T.S. Eliot wrote, "Humankind cannot bear very much reality."

You have only to look up at the Sistine Chapel ceiling in St. Peter's in Rome or listen to the King's College Choir in Cambridge to realise this. Science has not inspired art to anything like the same extent, but in my personal view, what science is doing is revealing a Universe whose complexity and beauty surpasses anything imagined by supernaturalists. To appreciate this, look at the breathtaking photographs taken by the Hubble Space Telescope. On the other hand, science lacks for some, but by no means all, people, the same emotional appeal as religion - it presents a view of human life that is bleak and joyless by comparison, because of the absence of any discernable, overall purpose in the Universe. This view conflicts with the purpose-driven, individual lives that we all lead. This relative lack of appeal is probably the main reason why the majority of people confine their interest in science to its useful applications or dangers, and turn to religion to __________, especially in times of grief and hardship. Belief in the supernatural provides the possibility of hope in circumstances where a naturalistic approach might provide none. As the poet T.S. Eliot wrote, "Humankind cannot bear very much reality."

① ( ① ) 뒤: 'This view conflicts with the purpose-driven, individual lives...' → 아직 '종교로 향하는 이유'가 설명되지 않은 단계. 부적절

③ ( ③ ) 뒤 ←정답
→ 앞: '...and turn to religion to seek meaning and comfort, especially in times of grief and hardship.' (사람들이 의미와 위안을 얻기 위해 종교로 향한다)
→ 주어진 문장이 이를 'In other words'로 재진술: 종교적 신념이 과학이 줄 수 없는 정서적 안식처를 제공한다는 의미

questions.stem:
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

Religious beliefs do have some major positive effects.

(A) It is also obvious that such beliefs have inspired and stimulated many forms of art, especially painting, sculpture, architecture and music.

(B) You have only to look up at the Sistine Chapel ceiling in St. Peter's in Rome or listen to the King's College Choir in Cambridge to realise this.

(C) For example, many people that run charities helping the poor and disadvantaged are motivated by their religious outlook.

det.korean: 자선 활동의 예시(C) → 예술에 준 영감(A) → 구체적 사례(B) 순서
det.analysis:
① (A) - (B) - (C)
→ (A)는 'such beliefs'로 시작하여 앞서 종교적 신념의 긍정적 효과에 대한 '예시'가 먼저 나와야 자연스러움. 도입문 직후에 바로 오기엔 비약

② (A) - (C) - (B)
→ (B)의 'to realise this'는 (A)의 예술 관련 진술을 가리켜야 하는데, 중간에 (C)가 끼어들면 지시 관계가 끊어짐

③ (C) - (B) - (A)
→ (B)의 'this'가 (A, 예술)를 지칭해야 하는데 (A)보다 먼저 나오면 지시 대상이 없음

④ (C) - (A) - (B) ←정답
→ 도입문(종교의 긍정적 효과) → (C): 첫 번째 예시로 자선 활동 언급(for example) → (A): 두 번째 예시로 예술에 준 영감 언급(It is also obvious that) → (B): 'to realise this'로 (A)의 예술적 영감을 구체적 사례(시스티나 성당, 킹스 칼리지 합창단)로 뒷받침
det.tip: 지시어(this)가 가리키는 대상이 앞에 먼저 나와야 한다. (B)의 'this'는 (A)의 예술적 영감을 가리킨다.

det.korean: 종교와 과학이 각각 주는 의미와 위안의 차이, 그리고 사람들이 여전히 종교에서 위안을 찾는 이유
det.analysis:
✅ ① 과학과 종교가 각각 주는 의미와 위안의 차이, 그리고 사람들이 여전히 종교에서 위안을 찾는 이유 — 글 전체가 종교의 긍정적 효과(자선, 예술)와 과학의 경이로움을 비교한 뒤, 과학이 종교만큼의 정서적 호소력이 없어 사람들이 결국 종교에서 의미와 위안을 찾는다는 결론으로 이어짐 ←정답
❌ ② 과학이 종교보다 예술 발전에 더 큰 영향을 미쳤다는 역사적 사실 — 원문은 반대로 과학이 예술에 준 영감이 종교보다 훨씬 적다고 명시
❌ ③ 허블 우주 망원경이 촉발한 천체물리학 연구의 최신 성과 — 허블 사진은 과학의 아름다움을 보여주는 하나의 예시일 뿐, 글의 중심 주제가 아님
❌ ④ T.S. 엘리엇의 문학 작품에 나타난 인간 본성에 대한 비판 — 엘리엇의 인용은 결론을 뒷받침하는 인용구일 뿐, 비판이 중심 주제가 아님
det.tip: 글의 도입(종교의 긍정적 효과)-전개(과학과의 비교)-결론(사람들이 종교에서 위안을 찾는 이유) 구조를 통해 중심 주제를 파악한다.
